speaker: Sheldon
text: So, shall we? How's it feel to get beaten up by a girl? It's not the first time. I have a twin sister whose assaults began in utero. If only I'd had the presence of mind to reabsorb her, then I'd have a mole with hair in it instead of a tedious yearly Christmas letter.

speaker: Benny
text: Gentlemen, have you come to the realization that the only reasonable course of action is to sell the ring and divide the money? Go ahead. Also my cousin.

speaker: Sheldon
text: No, I was afraid of that.

speaker: Venkatesh Kudrapalli
text: Greetings from Mumbai. I am Raj's attorney, Venkatesh Kudrapalli. Don't ask that. I'll get straight to the point. My client is prepared to surrender any interest he has in the ring in exchange for two Kawasaki jet skis.

speaker: Sheldon
text: We're not giving him two jet skis.

speaker: Venkatesh Kudrapalli
text: Look, we're big boys. Why don't we just cut to the chase and meet in the middle? One Kawasaki jet ski, done and done.

speaker: Venkatesh Kudrapalli
text: How did we get to jet skis?

speaker: Benny
text: Forget the jet skis! Those are lined in the sand! What happened to tear them a new one?

speaker: Venkatesh Kudrapalli
text: What can I say? We played hardball. We lost. I told you that when you hired me.

speaker: Venkatesh Kudrapalli
text: Call your mother and see why.
